assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original course cover and homepage banner for a Chinese cybersecurity awareness training application. Create a polished wide landscape editorial 3D illustration about account security: a large elegant teal shield and secure key, a smartphone with simple authentication symbols and a fingerprint, a few floating credential cards. Calm trustworthy navy (#12364a), deep teal (#0f766e), mint and warm off-white palette, refined soft lighting, subtle material texture, clear uncluttered shapes, ample breathing room, key subjects centered so they remain visible when cropped to 16:9. Friendly education for adults, technically neutral visual metaphor. No words, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no hooded hackers, no green code rain. Finished production illustration, not a UI screenshot.
